# JewelsReport

> JewelsReport is an internationally trusted, independent gemological certification laboratory
> issuing tamper-proof PVC certificates with holographic foil and QR-based instant online
> verification for natural and lab-grown diamonds, coloured gemstones and fine jewellery.
> Founded in Surat, India in 2014. 150,000+ reports issued across 30+ countries.

## What We Do

JewelsReport issues four categories of laboratory certification reports:

- **Lab Grown Diamond Reports** — Full 4Cs grading (cut, colour, clarity, carat weight) with complete origin disclosure for CVD and HPHT lab-grown diamonds. Includes shape, measurements, fluorescence, polish and symmetry grades.
- **Natural Jewellery Reports** — Comprehensive appraisal of finished jewellery including metal type, purity, total weight, stone identification, setting style and manufacturing quality assessment.
- **Gemstone Reports** — Scientific identification and authenticity verification for coloured gemstones including sapphire, ruby, emerald, alexandrite, spinel and all other precious and semi-precious stones. Treatments disclosed.
- **Lab Grown Jewellery Reports** — Grading of finished jewellery pieces containing lab-grown stones, with full transparency on stone origin and piece composition.

## Certificate Format

Every JewelsReport certificate is issued on a secure, credit-card-sized PVC card (CR80/PAN card format, 85.6 × 54 mm) featuring:
- Holographic foil security overlay
- Guilloché micro-pattern background
- Unique report number (formats: LGD-YY-XXXXXX / NDR-YY-XXXXXX / NJR-YY-XXXXXX / GEM-YY-XXXXXX)
- QR code linking to the live verification record at https://www.jewelsreport.com/verify

## Verification Process

1. Locate the report number on the PVC card (top-right corner)
2. Visit https://www.jewelsreport.com/verify or scan the QR code with any smartphone camera
3. Full grading details appear instantly — no login required, completely free

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is JewelsReport internationally recognised?**
Yes. JewelsReport certificates are trusted by diamond and jewellery traders in 30+ countries. Reports are accepted for retail, wholesale, insurance and export purposes.

**Can JewelsReport certificates be forged?**
Virtually impossible. Each card carries holographic foil, guilloché micro-pattern and a unique server-verified report number. Any forgery attempt is detectable by scanning the QR code.

**What is the difference between CVD and HPHT lab-grown diamonds?**
CVD (Chemical Vapour Deposition) grows diamonds from carbon-rich gas in a vacuum chamber. HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature) mimics the earth's mantle. JewelsReport identifies the growth method on every lab-grown diamond certificate.

**How do I get a certificate issued?**
Visit the lab in Surat or contact +91 99673 81180 / reports@jewelsreport.com. You submit the stone or jewellery piece; we return it with the graded PVC certificate within 3 business days.

**How long does grading take?**
Standard turnaround is 3 business days. Express service is available on request.

**Does JewelsReport grade natural diamonds?**
Yes. JewelsReport issues reports for natural diamonds, natural coloured gemstones, natural jewellery, lab-grown diamonds and lab-grown jewellery pieces.

**How do I verify a certificate I received?**
Go to https://www.jewelsreport.com/verify, enter the report number (e.g. LGD-26-123456) and press Verify. Full grading results appear immediately.

## Services vs Competitors

JewelsReport serves a similar function to GIA, IGI, HRD, AGS and EGL laboratories but specialises in the Indian market (Surat diamond hub) with a uniquely tamper-proof PVC card format and instant QR-based online verification. Turnaround times and pricing are competitive for the Indian and export market.
